rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the science-fiction genre in general.

example.english: I loved science fiction most when I was young.

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean science-fiction novels or literary fiction rather than the genre more broadly.

example.english: This science fiction novel is very imaginative.
